sections.heading: Section B: Written Questions (96 marks)
items: 1. Define the terms asset, liability and capital. (3 marks)
2. State three differences between a partnership and a sole proprietorship. (3 marks)
3. Record the following transactions in a simple ledger: started business with Ksh 50,000 cash; bought goods for Ksh 20,000 cash. (4 marks)
4. Name four factors of production and give the reward for each. (8 marks)
5. State two functions of the central bank of Kenya. (2 marks)
